analysis_result.analysis: The model failed to correctly reconstruct the temporal sequence of rope drawing. Although it correctly identified the colors present and even mapped cyan to blue, it assigned the wrong color to the second position in the drawing order. The ground truth clearly lists the ropes drawn in order: 1st purple, 2nd white, 3rd blue, etc. The model’s reasoning incorrectly placed yellow as second, indicating a breakdown in tracking the chronological order of events in the scene.
